myResources.title: My Resources
myResources.emptyDesc: Search for resources and save them here for easy access.

howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us what kind of support you need in plain English.
howItWorks.step1Back: Just type naturally - like talking to a friend. Ask about mental health, housing, financial aid, or anything else. Our AI understands context and finds the best matches for you.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We'll find relevant campus and Alberta services.
howItWorks.step2Back: Get personalized results based on your profile preferences. Each service shows eligibility, wait times, required documents, and step-by-step instructions to access help.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get clear steps, contact info, and track your progress.
howItWorks.step3Back: Save services to your personal hub. Track your progress through each step, mark completed tasks, and access contact info anytime. We're with you on your journey.
